statement: Chinese firms ordered more than two million H200 chips for 2026 against NVIDIA's total inventory of roughly 700,000 units, so orders far exceed available supply.
why: A roughly 3x order-to-inventory gap signals strong latent demand against tight whole-chain supply.

impact.mechanism: An order book well above inventory indicates undersupplied H200 stock and strong demand pull.

evidence.excerpt: Chinese tech companies collectively ordered more than two million H200 chips for 2026 against a total NVIDIA inventory of roughly 700,000 units
